scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @small-web/shared && npm run start:dev -w @small-web/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @small-web/shared && npm run dev -w @small-web/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @small-web/shared && npm run build -w @small-web/api && npm run build -w @small-web/web
scripts.seed: npm run build -w @small-web/shared && npm run seed -w @small-web/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @small-web/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
